No black, dark shadows, grey patches, darkened centre, lighting gradients, drop shadows, holes, pits, mottling, dense patterns, large leaves or outlines. Provide a 224x98 game sprite if possible; if larger, keep exactly this simple logical pixel structure. Only this one oval lawn, no text and no surrounding scenery.
packing: tools/pack_garden_floor.py: native-size indexed conversion with the original three gentle greens, closed opaque surface, transparent exterior; no black or dark shadow colours.
